cap.description: Linux capability set to apply (e.g., CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE). Must be a valid capability constant or comma-separated list. See /usr/include/linux/capability.h.

chroot.description: Path to chroot directory. Must be a valid, populated chroot environment.

user.description: Username to run the target program as. Requires root privileges.

group.description: Group name to run the target program as. Requires root privileges.

init_program.description: Path to an initialisation script or binary to execute before launching the main program (e.g., to prepare the chroot).

verbose.description: If true, enable verbose logging to stderr and syslog.

quiet.description: If true, suppress syslog output. Incompatible with --verbose.

fork.description: If true, fork to background after successful setup (mother process exits).

program.description: Absolute path to the program/service to run inside the compartment. Required.
